title: The Potential Effects and Mechanisms of Flax Lignans on Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to improving the lipid profile and glucose control in type 2 diabetic patients with supplementation of flax lignans. We hypothesize that flax lignans supplement will improve the cholesterol profile and glucose control in type 2 diabetic patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosed type 2 diabetes
* Age: 50-79 years old
* LDL-cholesterol more than 2.9 mmol/l

Exclusion Criteria:

* Current or previous (within 6 months) use of estrogen therapy
* Cancer
* Chronic gastrointestinal diseases
* Current use of antibiotics
* Any severe liver or renal diseases
* Systolic blood pressure more than 180 mmHg or phase 3 hypertension
* Any severe mental diseases
* Severe cardio- or cerebro-vascular diseases
